title: Ignore the Bishop on b1
setup: A black bishop has arrived on b1 next to your king and a rook waits on g2 — you appear to be the one in trouble.
hint: Being attacked is not the same as being lost. Look for your own check before you answer theirs.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qa8+}} walks past every threat. {{Rb8}} is the only block and {{Qxb8#}} takes it. When both kings are exposed, the position belongs to whoever moves first, not to whoever has more attackers.
